item.title: Biofeedback & Multisensory Immersion in VR (Master's Thesis)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An R&D environment investigating physiological correlations between human biometrics and subjective VR/PC flow states, featuring ESP32 telemetry, a custom Olfactory Display, and Python data science.

item.title: VR Simulator "Rouge Squadron" & Biometric Research
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An advanced cooperative VR spaceship simulator (LAN Multiplayer / Netcode) paired with clinical biometric research measuring player stress (EDA) and presence in VR.

item.title: Pestka Jam: 72-Hour Game Jam Organization & Developer Mentoring
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: Behind the scenes of organizing Pestka Jam with the Errno science club – 72 hours of intensive prototyping, technical mentoring, and game production.

item.title: LAB-VR - Open-Source Educational VR Platform
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An open-source classroom simulation in Virtual Reality (physics, astronomy, geology, hardware engineering) funded by Kowadło 2.0 and deployed across schools in Poland.

item.title: SNS Minerwa - Virtual Shooting Range
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An innovative virtual shooting training system based on computer vision, ESP32 rifle replica modifications, and Unity 3D.

item.title: Poznań Game Arena 2021 - Indie Booth Case Study & "Poszutex"
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A case study detailing Propaganda Studios’ indie booth at PGA 2021: welcoming hundreds of players, gathering real-time feedback, and shipping overnight bug fixes.
